name: Maria de Arcadare
original_name: マリア・ド・アークアデア
source:
The second princess of Arcadare. She is very stubborn, short-tempered and strong to the core, and isn't all that interested in Mamoru. What she admires in a man is coolness and wealth... Despite this, she starts liking him slowly and warming up to him. She loves her twin sister, Miria very much and thus, is sometimes a tad bit overprotective of her.

[Loosely translated from the [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=595945]Getchu Site[/url]]
